  <g id="content">
    <text x="24" y="236" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="26px" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">Create account</text>
    <text x="24" y="260" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="14px" font-weight="medium" fill="#667788">Join a community of people who love film.</text>

    <text x="24" y="291" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="12px" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">EMAIL OR PHONE</text>
    <rect x="23" y="299" width="344" height="50" rx="12" fill="#F7F9FA" stroke="#969696" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="40" y="330" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="16px" font-weight="medium" fill="#8899AA">you@example.com</text>

    <text x="24" y="378" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="12px" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">PASSWORD</text>

    <line x1="225" y1="548" x2="366" y2="548" stroke="#D9E1E8" stroke-width="1"/>

      <text x="324" y="598" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="12px" font-weight="bold" fill="#000000">Facebook</text>

    <text x="195" y="654" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="12px" font-weight="medium" fill="#667788">By signing up, you agree to our Terms and Privacy Policy.</text>
    <text x="195" y="690" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Display" font-size="14px" font-weight="medium" fill="#667788">Already have an account? <tspan fill="#00A83F" font-weight="bold">Sign In</tspan></text>
